{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine merino base layer: fitted long-sleeve crew neck, hip length, ivory (#F2EDE4), merino wool
Refined knit: relaxed-fit turtleneck, hip length, deep burgundy (#6B2D3C), fine-gauge merino wool
Trousers: straight-leg, full ankle length, charcoal (#3A3D42), wool-blend flannel
Thermal layer: fleece-lined leggings worn under the trousers, ankle length, black (#1C1C1E), stretch jersey with a brushed lining
Outer coat: insulated knee-length coat with a straight cut and a hood, dark navy (#1F2A3D), water-repellent technical fabric with a down fill
Ankle boots: waterproof, shearling-lined, low block heel with a deep-tread rubber sole, black (#1A1A1A), treated smooth leather
Socks: tall and cushioned, heather grey (#55585E), thick merino wool
Hat: close-fitting beanie that covers the ears, oatmeal (#CFC5B4), wool-cashmere blend
Scarf: long, wrapped twice around the neck, heather grey (#8E8E93), soft brushed wool
Gloves: wrist length, black (#1C1C1E), leather with a wool lining
Bag: structured tote with a top handle, black (#1A1A1A), water-resistant grained leather

This outfit keeps the neat office look of a refined knit with tailored trousers and ankle boots, while building warmth in layers for a 20-minute walk in deep frost. The merino base, thermal leggings and insulated coat hold heat in, and the water-repellent coat and waterproof boots handle snow. The treaded soles give grip on icy pavement, and the smooth leather is easy to wipe clean of road salt when you arrive. The burgundy knit adds some color against the dark neutrals, so you look polished at your desk once the coat, hat and scarf come off."}
